normalized.title: Iris IOC - ATN-IPS Standards Support
normalized.description:
The objective of this SoW is to provide Technical Support to the Iris Programme and in support of ATN/IPS standardisation in WP 3.3.2 of the ATN/IPS Project.

Work will be conducted under standards Development and Coordination (WP3.3) which aims to provide a structured approach for ATN/IPS standardisation efforts in order to align and coordinate all standardisation activities aspects of the FOC Work Stream, as well as for the IOC wide programme. The aim is to cover project wide activities transversal to Iris IOC and Iris FOC and requiring continuity of action such as SESAR coordination, and International Standardisation.

The main objective are to produce ATN/IPS technical notes and update the existing technical working papers to serve as input into additional standards activities. Prepare recommendations and inputs into ATN/IPS standards working groups, including AEEC, EUROCAE/RTCA/ICAO and others as appropriate and ensure that the current standards are sufficient for implementation of ATN/IPS functionality within the Iris context
